full_horizon_task_pilot.interpretation: The auxiliary optimization gain does not translate to success, return, or better action clipping at this training budget. Both methods are unusable closed-loop policies after 5000 steps.

paired_direction.action_clipping: auxiliary equal or worse in all three seeds
paired_direction.action_mae: auxiliary worse in two of three seeds
paired_direction.interior_observation_mae: auxiliary better in all three seeds

offline_heldout_diagnostic.interpretation: The failure exists before closed-loop compounding: generated actions are far less calibrated than held-out expert actions. Auxiliary iMF slightly improves interior state prediction but not the action component used by the controller.

algorithmic.evidence_for: auxiliary iMF improves interval optimization and interior state error but not action error, showing objective-component mismatch
algorithmic.evidence_against: the auxiliary mechanism itself is stable across three training seeds

data.evidence_for: task-wide coverage remains unaudited for this specific failure
data.evidence_against: held-out expert first actions have zero clipping and reasonable scale

representation.evidence_for: five action dimensions share an elementwise objective with 83 observation dimensions and receive action_weight 1
representation.evidence_against: the same state/action representation is executable and finite

temporal.evidence_against: severe action error is already present on independent held-out windows

control.evidence_for: more than 79 percent of actions require environment clipping
control.evidence_against: offline action miscalibration exists before controller interaction

next_hypothesis.statement: the default action_weight of 1 undertrains the executed action relative to the 83-dimensional state trajectory
next_hypothesis.evidence: original EC-Diffuser PushCube configs use action_weight 10; the OGBench iMF protocol omitted it and inherited 1
next_hypothesis.required_ablation: one seed, auxiliary iMF only, action_weight 10 versus the frozen action_weight 1 checkpoint; all other settings unchanged

claims_not_supported: auxiliary iMF is ready for full training
the failure is caused solely by action weighting
